notes.title: Happy Birthday, Mr. Bastos!
notes.content:
[h1] Happy birthday, The New California! [/h1] 

This November, The New California makes a year of release!

2018 was an amazing and very special year! We circulated with educational experiences of the game, and many people were able to play and talk about themes related to Lima Barreto's universe.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578700/8000087409f5f05c2ff54c7c52aa45106c73d19a.jpg[/img]

Brazilian culture, popular literature, black consciousness, history, and many other topics. This year, it was surprising how many of you took advantage of the game experience and brought such important discussions to all of us. We've been looking for that a lot, but the discussions you've brought have surpassed our expectations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30578700/0cb6ab8ef7a0745b280555ce017fda172839b017.jpg[/img]

Next year, we will reposition some things in the game. We will seek to further enhance the cultural elements present in the game. Much more than a game, we will continue to circulate around with the mediated experiences and chats that greatly enrich the proposal.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33368914/d831b39a771f55c1f11d95d68d1945ccbbcbc11d.jpg[/img]

For you, we thank you!

Game is culture! Game is knowledge!

Hugs!

Jaderson Souza and Tainá Felix :: Game e Arte

notes.title: Spanish Subtitles!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, friends![/h1]

[h1] Spanish subtitles are now available! [/h1] 

Giving attention and care for all of you, we are adding materials in diferente languages. As soon as possible, another options will be available!

If you want to participate by sending your fan translation, we will be happy by sendind to you Amora´s spreadsheet and, after, we can implemente it! It will be a great contribution to your local community, because this experience may be more accessible for all friends.

Thanks for your support!

Hugs,

Jaderson e Tainá
Game e Arte
